name: Legacy: Avg Traces per Thread

queries.name: main
queries.sql:
SELECT day, avg(trace_count) AS avg_traces_per_thread
FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfDay(OccurredAt) AS day, ConversationId, count() AS trace_count
  FROM trace_metrics
  WHERE OccurredAt >= {period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {period_end:DateTime}
    AND ConversationId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY day, ConversationId
)
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day
